mentions.name: Concludia MCP server
mentions.description: A private MCP server for Concludia whose tools let an LLM read and validate Concludia arguments; it generated the counterpoints for the "carbon offset" argument.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've actually had a lot of fun hooking it up to LLM. I have a private MCP server for it. The tools tell it how to read a concludia argument and validate it. It's what generated all the counterpoints for the "carbon offset" argument
